result.summary: No critical breakage is visible. The main issues are awkward horizontal clipping at the right edge and content appearing beneath the fixed bottom navigation.

issues.description: The category selector ends with a partially visible, unlabeled pill at the right edge, which looks like a clipped or broken control.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the horizontal carousel padding or initial scroll position so the next category shows enough label to be recognizable, or hide it fully until scrolling.

issues.description: The third card in the “Fastest near you” row is heavily cut off, including its restaurant name, creating an abrupt edge rather than a clear carousel preview.
issues.suggestion: Use consistent card widths and right-side padding so a deliberate portion of the next card is visible without clipping its text awkwardly.

issues.description: The lower restaurant card extends behind the fixed bottom navigation, making the content appear partially obscured.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the scrolling content has adequate bottom inset or padding equal to the navigation bar and device safe area.
